en.s: The Battle of Jicheng was fought between the state of Former Yan against the Later Zhao dynasty from 12 to 16 June 338 during the Sixteen Kingdoms period. Following the breakdown of their alliance against the Duan tribe, the battle concluded in victory for the Yan.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 蓟城战役于338年6月12日至16日十六国时期爆发，交战双方是前燕和后赵。段部联盟瓦解后，两国之间爆发战斗，最终燕军获胜。

en.s: The sack of Rome in 455 was carried out by the Vandals led by their king Gaiseric. A 442 treaty between the Western Roman Empire and Vandal Kingdom included a marriage of state between the daughter of Roman Emperor Valentinian III and the son of Gaiseric. Valentinian's successor Petronius Maximus violated the treaty by marrying his son to Valentinian's daughter, and Gaiseric retaliated with an invasion of Italy.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 455年，汪达尔国王盖萨里克率军洗劫罗马。442年西罗马帝国与汪达尔王国签约，约定皇帝瓦伦提尼安三世的女儿与盖萨里克的儿子联姻。瓦伦提尼安的继任者佩特罗尼乌斯·马克西穆斯却让自己的儿子与她成婚，违反了条约；盖萨里克随后入侵意大利。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The battle of Colle di Val d'Elsa took place between 16 and 17 June 1269 at Colle di Val d'Elsa between the Ghibelline troops of Siena and the Guelph troops of Charles of Anjou and Florence, represented by fewer than 200 knights commanded by Neri de' Bardi.

zh.t: 科莱瓦尔德埃尔萨战役
zh.s: 科莱瓦尔德埃尔萨战役于1269年6月16日至17日在意大利科莱瓦尔德埃尔萨爆发，交战双方是锡耶纳的吉伯林派军队，以及安茹的查理和佛罗伦萨的归尔甫派军队。后者由内里·德·巴尔迪指挥，不到200名骑士。

en.s: The siege of Copenhagen (Danish: Belejringen af København) or the Capture of Copenhagen (Danish: Overtagelsen af København), was a looting and siege of Copenhagen and Absalon's Castle in 1368 between Denmark and the Hanseatic League, during the Danish-Hanseatic War (1361–1370). The city was looted and Absalon's castle was destroyed.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1368年丹麦与汉萨同盟交战期间，汉萨军围攻并洗劫哥本哈根及阿布萨隆城堡。城市遭到掠夺，阿布萨隆城堡被毁。

en.s: The Battle of Aussig (German: Schlacht bei Aussig) or Battle of Ústí nad Labem (Czech: Bitva u Ústí nad Labem) was fought on 16 June 1426, between Roman Catholic crusaders and the Hussites during the Fourth Crusade of the Hussite Wars. It was fought near Aussig (Ústí nad Labem) in northern Bohemia. The crusade was called because the Pope believed that the Hussite armies would be easily defeated after the death of Jan Žižka. The overall commander of the Hussite forces at the battle was Sigismund Korybut, while Prokop the Great was independently in command of the Taborites.

zh.s: 乌斯季战役也称乌斯季纳德拉贝姆战役，于1426年6月16日爆发，交战双方是罗马天主教十字军和胡斯战争第四次十字军东征期间的胡斯派军队。战斗发生在波希米亚北部乌斯季（乌斯季纳德拉贝姆）附近。教皇认为杨·杰式卡去世后胡斯军队很容易被击败，因此号召发动十字军。胡斯军队的总指挥是西吉斯蒙德·科里布特，塔博尔派则由普罗科普大帝独立指挥。

en.s: The Battle of Bazel was fought in the Belgian village of Bazel on June 16, 1452 between an army under the Philip III, Duke of Burgundy and the rebelling city of Ghent. The battle was part of the Revolt of Ghent, and a victory for the Duke.

zh.s: 巴泽尔战役于1452年6月16日在比利时巴泽尔村爆发，交战双方是勃艮第公爵菲利普三世率领的军队和反叛的根特市军队。战役是根特起义的一部分，最终以公爵获胜告终。

en.s: The Battle of Stoke Field on 16 June 1487 may be considered the last battle of the Wars of the Roses, since it was the last major engagement between contenders for the throne whose claims derived from descent from the houses of Lancaster and York respectively. The Battle of Bosworth, two years previously, had established King Henry VII on the throne, ending the last period of Yorkist rule and initiating that of the Tudors. The Battle of Stoke Field was the decisive engagement in an attempt by leading Yorkists to unseat him in favour of the pretender Lambert Simnel.

zh.s: 斯托克菲尔德战役于1487年6月16日爆发，有时被视为玫瑰战争的最后一场战役，因为这是兰开斯特家族和约克家族后裔争夺王位的最后一次重大交战。两年前的博斯沃思战役使亨利七世登上王位，结束约克王朝的最后一段统治，并开启都铎王朝时期。斯托克菲尔德战役是约克派领袖试图推翻亨利、拥立冒名者兰伯特·西姆内尔的关键战斗。

en.t: Henry VII defeats the Yorkist rebels at Stoke Field
en.s: On June 16, 1487, King Henry VII's army defeated a Yorkist rebel force at Stoke Field in present-day Nottinghamshire, England. The rebels backed Lambert Simnel as a rival claimant to the throne. The battle is commonly regarded as the last major engagement of the Wars of the Roses.
en.n: The dated event is the Battle of Stoke Field, not an event in Ireland.

zh.t: 亨利七世在斯托克菲尔德击败约克派叛军
zh.s: 1487年6月16日，英王亨利七世的军队在今英格兰诺丁汉郡斯托克菲尔德击败约克派叛军。叛军拥立兰伯特·西姆内尔争夺王位；这场战役通常被视为玫瑰战争最后一次重大战斗。
zh.n: 这一天发生的是英格兰斯托克菲尔德战役，不是爱尔兰境内的事件。

en.s: The Battle of Little Belt was a naval battle between a combined Swedish/Danish/Prussian fleet and a fleet from Lübeck on 16 June 1535, during the Count's Feud. The battle ended in a heavy defeat for Lübeck.

zh.s: 小贝尔特海战于1535年6月16日伯爵战争期间爆发，交战双方是瑞典、丹麦和普鲁士联军舰队与吕贝克舰队。吕贝克遭到惨败。

en.s: The Battle of Tashiskari (Georgian: ტაშისკარის ბრძოლა) was fought between the Georgians and the Ottomans at the village of Tashiskari on June 16, 1609. The Georgians, led by Giorgi Saakadze won a victory over the Ottomans.

zh.s: 塔希斯卡里战役（格鲁吉亚语：ტაშისკარის ბრძოლა）于1609年6月16日在塔希斯卡里村爆发，交战双方是格鲁吉亚人和奥斯曼人。吉奥尔吉·萨阿卡泽率领格鲁吉亚军队获胜。

en.s: The Battle of Glenmaquin was a battle on 16 June 1642 during the Irish Confederate Wars, the Irish theatre of the Wars of the Three Kingdoms. It was fought between the forces of Confederate Ireland under Sir Phelim O'Neill and the Laggan Army under Sir Robert and Sir William Stewart. The battle ended in a decisive victory for the Laggan Army.

zh.s: 格伦马克因战役于1642年6月16日爱尔兰邦联战争期间爆发，该战争是三王国战争在爱尔兰的战场。交战双方是菲利姆·奥尼尔爵士指挥的爱尔兰邦联军，以及罗伯特·斯图尔特爵士和威廉·斯图尔特爵士指挥的拉根军。拉根军取得决定性胜利。

en.s: The siege of Lyme Regis was an eight-week blockade during the First English Civil War. The port of Lyme Regis, in Dorset, was considered to be of strategic importance because it controlled the main shipping route between Bristol and the English Channel. Thomas Ceeley and Robert Blake commanded the town's Parliamentarian defences during the siege, which was laid by Prince Maurice between 20 April and 16 June 1644. At the start of the war, Lyme Regis was claimed by a pair of local members of parliament, and garrisoned for the Parliamentarians.

zh.s: 莱姆里吉斯围城战是第一次英国内战期间持续8周的一次封锁。多塞特郡的莱姆里吉斯港控制着布里斯托尔与英吉利海峡之间的主要航线，因此具有战略意义。围城由莫里斯亲王于1644年4月20日至6月16日发起，托马斯·西利和罗伯特·布莱克负责指挥城内议会军防御。战争开始时，当地两名议员宣称拥有莱姆里吉斯，该镇随后驻扎了议会军。

en.s: The Battle of Orbetello, also known as the Battle of Isola del Giglio, was a major naval engagement of the Franco-Spanish War of 1635. It was fought on 14 June 1646 off the Spanish-ruled town of Orbetello, on the coast of Tuscany, Italy, between a French fleet led by Admiral Armand de Maillé, Marquis of Brézé, and a Spanish fleet commanded by Miguel de Noronha, 4th Count of Linhares sent to break the blockade of Orbetello and relieve the town, besieged since 12 May by a French army commanded by Prince Thomas of Savoy.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 奥尔贝泰洛海战又称吉廖岛海战，是1635年起法西战争中的一次大型海战。1646年6月14日，阿尔芒·德·马耶、布雷泽侯爵率领的法国舰队，在意大利托斯卡纳海岸、西班牙统治的奥尔贝泰洛近海，与米格尔·德·诺罗尼亚、第四代利尼亚雷斯伯爵率领的西班牙舰队交战。西班牙舰队试图打破法国封锁，解救自5月12日起遭托马斯·萨伏依亲王率军围攻的城镇。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Sinsheim was a victory of the Vicomte de Turenne, over forces from the Holy Roman Empire on 16 June 1674, during the Franco-Dutch War. The battle was fought in Sinsheim (southeast of Heidelberg), not Sinzheim (near Baden-Baden) as it is often presumed.

zh.s: 辛斯海姆战役发生于1674年6月16日，是蒂雷纳子爵率领的军队击败神圣罗马帝国军队的一场胜利，属于法荷战争的一部分。战斗发生在海德堡东南的辛斯海姆，而非常被误认为的巴登-巴登附近辛茨海姆。

en.s: The Battle of Imbros was a naval clash that took place on 12, 13 and 16 June 1717 near Imbros in the Aegean Sea, between the sailing fleets of Venice and the Ottoman Empire. The outnumbered Venetian Armada Grossa, under the Capitano Straordinario delle Navi Lodovico Flangini, proved herself able to match a superior Turkish force under the Kapudan Pasha Hodja Ibrahim Pasha in a manoeuvred fight that lasted nearly ten days.

zh.s: 因布罗斯海战是1717年6月12日、13日和16日在爱琴海因布罗斯附近发生的一系列海战，交战双方是威尼斯和奥斯曼帝国的帆船舰队。威尼斯舰队规模较小，由威尼斯特别舰队司令洛多维科·弗兰吉尼指挥，但在机动战中证明自己能够与霍贾·易卜拉欣帕夏指挥的优势土耳其舰队抗衡。战斗持续近10天。

en.s: The Battle of Piacenza was fought between a Franco-Spanish army and the Austrian army near Piacenza, in Northern Italy on June 16, 1746. It formed part of later operations in the War of the Austrian Succession. The result was a victory for the Austrian forces, led by Prince Josef Wenzel. Prince Franz Josef I and Louis-Joseph de Montcalm were among the notable combatants.

zh.s: 皮亚琴察战役于1746年6月16日在意大利北部皮亚琴察附近爆发，交战双方是法西联军和奥地利军队，是奥地利王位继承战争后期军事行动的一部分。约瑟夫·文策尔亲王率领的奥军获胜。弗朗茨·约瑟夫一世亲王和路易-约瑟夫·德·蒙卡尔姆也是参战的重要人物。

en.s: On June 16, 1760, a force of Rogers' Rangers led by Robert Rogers raided and burned Fort Sainte-Thérèse on the Richelieu River in present-day Quebec, Canada. The attack was part of the British campaign against New France during the Seven Years' War. French troops soon rebuilt the fort, so its destruction on this date was temporary.
en.n: June 16 is the fort's destruction during the wider raid; French forces rebuilt it soon afterward.

zh.t: 罗杰斯游骑兵焚毁圣特蕾莎堡
zh.s: 1760年6月16日，罗伯特·罗杰斯率领的游骑兵袭击并焚毁圣特蕾莎堡。堡垒位于今天加拿大魁北克省的黎塞留河畔。这次袭击是七年战争期间英军进攻新法兰西的一部分；法军不久后重建了堡垒。
zh.n: 6月16日是这场袭击中堡垒被焚毁的日期；法军随后很快将其重建。

en.s: The Great Siege of Gibraltar was an unsuccessful attempt by Spain and France to capture Gibraltar from Britain during the American Revolutionary War. It was the largest battle in the war by number of combatants. On 16 June 1779, Spain entered the war on the side of France with the primary war aim of capturing Gibraltar from the British.

zh.s: 直布罗陀大围城战是美国独立战争期间西班牙和法国试图从英国手中夺取直布罗陀但未能成功的一次围城战。这是战争中参战人数最多的战斗。1779年6月16日，西班牙加入法国一方参战，主要战争目标是从英国手中夺取直布罗陀。

en.s: The Battle of Uransari or the Battle of Kachis Capel took place on June 16, 1790 during the Russo-Swedish War (1788–1790).

zh.s: 乌兰萨里战役也称卡奇斯卡佩尔战役，于1790年6月16日俄瑞战争（1788—1790）期间爆发。

en.s: The Battle of Lambusart (16 June 1794) saw a Republican French army led by Jean Baptiste Jourdan try to cross the Sambre River against a combined Dutch and Habsburg Austrian army under William VI, Hereditary Prince of Orange. This battle was the culmination of the fourth of five attempts to consolidate a foothold on the north side of the Sambre.

zh.s: 兰布萨尔战役于1794年6月16日爆发。让-巴蒂斯特·儒尔当率领的共和法国军队试图渡过桑布尔河，遭到威廉六世、奥兰治世袭亲王指挥的荷兰和哈布斯堡奥地利联军阻击。这是法国军队五次试图在桑布尔河北岸巩固据点中的第四次，也是该行动的高潮。

en.s: Cornwallis's Retreat was a naval engagement during the French Revolutionary Wars in which a British Royal Navy squadron of five ships of the line and two frigates was attacked by a much larger French Navy fleet of 12 ships of the line and 11 frigates. The action took place in the waters off the west coast of Brittany on 16–17 June 1795 (28–29 Prairial an III of the French Republican Calendar).
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 康沃利斯撤退战是法国大革命战争期间的一场海战。英国皇家海军一支由5艘战列舰和2艘护卫舰组成的舰队，遭到法国海军一支规模大得多的舰队攻击，后者有12艘战列舰和11艘护卫舰。战斗于1795年6月16日至17日在布列塔尼西岸海域发生（法国共和历三年牧月二十八日至二十九日）。

en.s: The Battle of Ligny (16 June 1815) was the last victory of the military career of Napoleon I. In this battle, French troops of the Armée du Nord under Napoleon's command, defeated part of a Prussian army under Field Marshal Blücher, near Ligny in present-day Belgium. The Battle of Ligny is a prime example of a tactical win and a strategic loss, in that the bulk of the Prussian army survived and went on to play a pivotal role two days later at the Battle of Waterloo, reinforced by IV Prussian corps that had not participated in the battle at Ligny.

zh.s: 利尼战役于1815年6月16日爆发，是拿破仑一世军事生涯中的最后一场胜利。拿破仑指挥北方军团的法军，在今比利时利尼附近击败布吕歇元帅率领的部分普鲁士军队。此战是战术胜利、战略失利的典型例子：大部分普军幸存，并于两天后在滑铁卢战役中发挥关键作用，此外还有未参加利尼战役的普鲁士第四军加入。

en.s: The Battle of Quatre Bras was fought on 16 June 1815, two days before the Battle of Waterloo. The battle was contested between Wellington's Anglo-allied army and the left wing of the Armée du Nord under Marshal Michel Ney.

zh.s: 四臂村战役于1815年6月16日爆发，距滑铁卢战役两天。交战双方是威灵顿的英盟军和米歇尔·内伊元帅指挥的北方军团左翼。

en.t: A strong earthquake in the Kutch district of Gujarat, India, caused a local zone of uplift that dammed the Nara River, which was later named the Allah Bund ('Dam of God')
en.s: The 1819 Rann of Kutch earthquake occurred at about 18:45 to 18:50 local time on 16 June 1819. It had an estimated magnitude ranging from 7.7 to 8.2 on the moment magnitude scale and a maximum perceived intensity of XI (Extreme) on the Mercalli intensity scale. It triggered a tsunami and caused at least 1,543 deaths.

zh.s: 1819年库奇地震于当地时间6月16日约18时45分至18时50分发生，震中位于印度古吉拉特邦库奇地区。地震在当地造成地面隆起，堵塞纳拉河，后来形成的堤坝被称为阿拉邦德（意为“真主之堤”）。震级估计为7.7至8.2级，麦加利地震烈度最高达到XI级（极强）。地震引发海啸，造成至少1,543人死亡。

en.s: The Battle of Horseshoe Bend, also referred to as the Battle of Pecatonica and the Battle of Bloody Lake, was fought on June 16, 1832, in present-day Wisconsin at an oxbow lake known as "Horseshoe Bend", which was formed by a change in course of the Pecatonica River. The battle was a major turning point in the Black Hawk War, despite being of only minor military significance.

zh.s: 马蹄湾战役也称佩卡托尼卡战役或血湖战役，于1832年6月16日在今威斯康星州爆发，地点是佩卡托尼卡河改道后形成的一处牛轭湖，即“马蹄湾”。这场战斗的军事意义不大，但却是黑鹰战争的重要转折点。

en.s: The Battle of Wusong (Woosung) (Chinese: 吳淞戰役) was fought between British and Chinese forces at the entrance of the Wusong River (present-day Huangpu River), Jiangsu province, China, on 16 June 1842, during the First Opium War. The British capture of the towns of Woosung (now Wusong) and Baoshan opened the way to Shanghai, which was captured with little resistance on 19 June.

zh.s: 吴淞战役（中文：吴淞战役）于1842年6月16日第一次鸦片战争期间爆发，交战双方是英国和中国军队，地点在江苏吴淞江（今黄浦江）入海口。英军攻占吴淞和宝山，为进军上海打开通道；上海于6月19日在几乎没有抵抗的情况下被攻占。

zh.s: 1849年6月16日，匈牙利革命军与哈布斯堡帝国军队在日加尔德交战。这是1848—1849年匈牙利独立战争夏季战役的一部分。当天，阿什博特·拉约什上校率匈牙利第二军占领日加尔德、基拉伊雷夫、内杰德和法尔卡什德等地，随后遭奥军反击。

en.s: The Filibuster War, also referred to the Walker affair and known in Costa Rica as the National Campaign of 1856–1857, was a war fought in Central America between 1855 and 1857. The militaries of Costa Rica, El Salvador, Guatemala, Honduras, and Nicaragua established the Allied Central American Army and fought against American filibusters led by William Walker who had taken over the Nicaraguan government.

zh.t: 中美洲反威廉·沃克战争
zh.s: 1855年至1857年，中美洲国家与美国冒险家威廉·沃克及其部队交战；此事也称沃克事件，在哥斯达黎加称为1856—1857年“国民战役”。哥斯达黎加、萨尔瓦多、危地马拉、洪都拉斯和尼加拉瓜军队组成中美洲联军，对抗已夺取尼加拉瓜政府的沃克。

en.s: The Dunedin Country by-election 1858 was a by-election held in the multi-member Dunedin Country electorate during the 2nd New Zealand Parliament, on 16 June 1858. The by-election was caused by the resignation of incumbent MP John Cargill and was won by John Taylor.

zh.s: 1858年达尼丁乡村选区补选是新西兰第二届议会期间在多席位达尼丁乡村选区举行的一次补选，投票日期为1858年6月16日。时任议员约翰·卡吉尔辞职后，该席位出缺，约翰·泰勒赢得补选。

en.s: The Battle of Secessionville (or the First Battle of James Island) was fought on June 16, 1862, during the American Civil War. Confederate forces defeated the Union's only attempt to capture Charleston, South Carolina, by land.

zh.s: 分离维尔战役也称詹姆斯岛第一次战役，于1862年6月16日美国内战期间爆发。邦联军击败联邦军，这是联邦军唯一一次试图从陆路攻占南卡罗来纳州查尔斯顿。

en.s: The Pinhook Draw fight took place June 15–16, 1881, near Moab, Utah. It was part of a series of clashes between the Ute people and Anglo-American settlers sometimes termed the Ute Wars. The combatants were 30 to 65 Ute and Paiute people and about three dozen white settlers, mostly cowboys and miners from southwestern Colorado and southeastern Utah.

en.t: The first purpose-built roller coaster, LaMarcus Adna Thompson's "Switchback Railway", opens in New York's Coney Island amusement park
en.s: The original Switchback Railway was the first roller coaster at Coney Island in Brooklyn, New York City, and one of the earliest designed for amusement in the United States. The 1885 patent states the invention relates to the gravity double track switchback railway, which had predicated the inclined plane railway, patented in 1878 by Richard Knudsen. Coney Island's version was designed by LaMarcus Adna Thompson in 1881 and constructed in 1884.

zh.t: 首座专为游乐设计的过山车“Switchback Railway”在纽约康尼岛开放
zh.s: 最初的Switchback Railway是布鲁克林康尼岛的第一座过山车，也是美国最早专为游乐设计的过山车之一。1885年的专利说明，这项发明涉及重力驱动的双轨折返式铁路；该设计以理查德·克努森1878年取得专利的斜坡铁路为前身。康尼岛这座设施由拉马库斯·阿德纳·汤普森于1881年设计，1884年建成。

en.s: The 1894 Sanitary Board Election was supposed to be held on 16 June 1894 was the second election for the 2 unofficial seats in the Sanitary Board of Hong Kong. Only persons on the jury lists of the year were eligible to vote. There were only two candidates therefore there was no formal election was held. John Joseph Francis was elected for the third time. During the election, the outbreak of the bubonic plague caused devastating damages to the colony. The plague raised the issue of the composition and power of the Sanitary Board.

zh.s: 香港卫生局选举原定于1894年6月16日举行，这是卫生局两个非官守席位的第二次选举。只有当年陪审员名单上的人有投票资格。由于只有两名候选人，因此没有正式投票；约翰·约瑟夫·弗朗西斯第三次当选。选举期间，腺鼠疫爆发并给殖民地造成严重损失，也引发了对卫生局组成和权力的讨论。

zh.s: 德国于1898年6月16日举行联邦选举。尽管社会民主党（SPD）获得最多选票，中央党仍以397席中的102席成为国会最大党，社会民主党仅获56席。投票率为68.1%。

en.t: It was founded by Henry Ford and incorporated on June 16, 1903
en.s: The Ford Motor Company (commonly known as Ford, sometimes abbreviated as FoMoCo) is an American multinational automobile manufacturer headquartered in Dearborn, Michigan, United States. It was founded by Henry Ford and incorporated on June 16, 1903. The company sells automobiles and commercial vehicles under the Ford brand, and luxury cars under its Lincoln brand.

zh.s: 福特汽车公司通常简称福特，有时也缩写为FoMoCo，是一家总部位于美国密歇根州迪尔伯恩的跨国汽车制造商。公司由亨利·福特创立，并于1903年6月16日注册成立。公司以福特品牌销售汽车和商用车辆，并以林肯品牌销售豪华汽车。

en.s: The assassination of Nikolay Bobrikov took place on 16 June [O.S. 3 June] 1904 when Finnish nationalist Eugen Schauman shot and killed the Governor-General of Finland, Nikolay Bobrikov, on a staircase in the Government Palace, which at the time was the main building of the Senate of Finland. After shooting Bobrikov, Schauman shot and killed himself.

zh.t: 尼古拉·博布里科夫遇刺案
zh.s: 1904年6月16日（儒略历6月3日），芬兰民族主义者欧根·绍曼在政府宫楼梯上枪杀芬兰总督尼古拉·博布里科夫。政府宫当时是芬兰参议院的主要办公楼。绍曼开枪击毙博布里科夫后，也开枪自杀。

en.s: The 1905 All-Ireland Senior Football Championship final was the eighteenth All-Ireland Final and the deciding match of the 1905 All-Ireland Senior Football Championship, an inter-county Gaelic football tournament for the top teams in Ireland.

zh.t: 1905年全爱尔兰高级足球锦标赛决赛
zh.s: 1905年全爱尔兰高级足球锦标赛决赛是第18届全爱尔兰决赛，也是1905年该项锦标赛的决胜赛。这项赛事由爱尔兰各郡顶级球队参加，比赛项目为盖尔式足球。
zh.n: 标题中的“1905年”指锦标赛届次；决赛于1907年6月16日举行。

en.s: The Auckland East by-election was a by-election in the New Zealand electorate of Auckland East, an urban seat at the top of the North Island. The by-election was held on 16 June 1910, and was precipitated by the death of sitting Liberal MP Frederick Baume.

zh.s: 新西兰奥克兰东区选区于1910年6月16日举行补选。自由党现任议员弗雷德里克·鲍姆去世后，该席位出缺。

en.s: The Fourth Battle of Topolobampo was a single ship action fought during the Mexican Revolution and the last naval battle of the Topolobampo Campaign. In June 1914, a Huertista gunboat sank a Constitutionalist gunboat off Topolobampo, Sinaloa in the Gulf of California.

zh.t: 第四次托波洛班波海战
zh.s: 第四次托波洛班波海战是墨西哥革命期间的一次单舰交战，也是托波洛班波战役的最后一场海战。1914年6月，拥护韦尔塔的炮舰在加利福尼亚湾、锡那罗亚州托波洛班波近海击沉一艘立宪派炮舰。

en.s: The Malgaç Raid was a raid conducted by Yörük Ali Efe and his men on 16 June 1919. The target of the raid was the Malgaç railway bridge, which was used by the Greeks to transport military equipment to Nazilli and beyond. It was one of the first organized civil resistance attacks against the invading Greek forces in western Anatolia.

zh.s: 马尔加奇突袭由约吕克·阿里·埃费及其部下于1919年6月16日发动。突袭目标是马尔加奇铁路桥，希腊军队利用这座桥向纳齐利及更远地区运送军事装备。这是安纳托利亚西部抵抗希腊入侵军的首批有组织民间抵抗行动之一。

en.s: The Rathcoole ambush (Irish: Luíochán Ráth Cúil) was an ambush carried out by the Irish Republican Army (IRA) near the village of Rathcoole in County Cork on 16 June 1921 during the Irish War of Independence. Under the command of Paddy O'Brien, the IRA's 2nd Cork Brigade attacked an armed convoy of the Auxiliary Division returning to their barracks in Millstreet after collecting supplies.

zh.s: 拉斯库尔伏击是爱尔兰共和军于1921年6月16日在科克郡拉斯库尔村附近发动的一次伏击，发生在爱尔兰独立战争期间。帕迪·奥布莱恩指挥爱尔兰共和军科克第二旅，袭击了一支武装辅助部队车队；车队刚收集完物资，正返回米尔斯特里特军营。

en.s: The 1922 Irish general election took place in Southern Ireland on Friday, 16 June. The election was separately called by a resolution of Dáil Éireann on 19 May and by an order of the Provisional Government on 27 May. The body elected was thus both the 3rd Dáil and provisional parliament replacing the parliament of Southern Ireland, under the provisions of the 1921 Anglo-Irish Treaty to elect a constituent assembly paving the way for the formal establishment of the Irish Free State.

zh.s: 爱尔兰南部于1922年6月16日星期五举行大选。爱尔兰众议院于5月19日通过决议另行宣布选举，临时政府也于5月27日下令举行选举。因此，当选的机构既是第三届众议院，也是取代爱尔兰南部议会的临时议会。根据1921年《英爱条约》，这次选举将选出制宪会议，为正式成立爱尔兰自由邦铺路。

en.s: The June 16 Incident, also known as the Guangzhou uprising or the Chen Jiongming Rebellion, was a coup d'état led by Chen Jiongming against the Guangzhou government on June 16, 1922. The conflict began due to a dispute between Sun Yat-sen's policy of beginning the Northern Expedition and uniting China forcefully, and Chen Jiongming's policy of creating a federalist constitution.

zh.s: 6月16日事件也称广州起义或陈炯明叛乱，是陈炯明于1922年6月16日针对广州政府发动的一场政变。冲突源于孙中山主张发动北伐、以武力统一中国，而陈炯明则主张建立联邦制宪法，双方政策发生分歧。

en.t: Whampoa Military Academy holds its opening ceremony
en.s: The Whampoa Military Academy held its formal opening ceremony on June 16, 1924, on Changzhou Island in Guangzhou, China. Sun Yat-sen addressed the ceremony. The academy had been planned earlier in the year and had already begun enrolling its first students in May; June 16 marks the public opening ceremony, not the first day of planning or enrollment.
en.n: June 16 is the formal opening ceremony; first students began enrollment in May 1924.

zh.t: 黄埔军校举行开学典礼
zh.s: 1924年6月16日，黄埔军校在广州长洲岛举行开学典礼，孙中山到场演讲。学校在当年早些时候已开始筹办，首批学生从5月起入学。这一天正式举行的是开学典礼。
zh.n: 首批学生从1924年5月开始入学；6月16日举行开学典礼。

en.t: Artek, the most famous Young Pioneer camp of the Soviet Union, is established
en.s: Artek (Russian: Артек) is an international children's center (a former Young Pioneer camp) on the Black Sea in the town of Gurzuf located on the Crimean Peninsula, near Ayu-Dag. It was established on 16 June 1925 as the V. I. Lenin All-Union Pioneer Camp. Artek was considered to be a privilege for Soviet children during its existence, as well as for children from other communist countries.

zh.t: 苏联著名少年先锋营阿尔捷克成立
zh.s: 阿尔捷克是位于克里米亚半岛古尔祖夫镇、黑海沿岸的一处国际儿童中心，过去曾是少年先锋营。它于1925年6月16日成立，最初名为“列宁全联盟少年先锋营”。在苏联时期，阿尔捷克被视为苏联儿童以及其他共产主义国家儿童享有的特权。

en.s: A by-election was held for the Australian House of Representatives seat of Martin on 16 June 1928. This was triggered by the death of Nationalist MP and Trade and Customs Minister Herbert Pratten. The by-election was won by the Nationalist candidate, Pratten's nephew Graham.

zh.s: 澳大利亚众议院马丁选区于1928年6月16日举行补选。民族党议员兼贸易与关税部长赫伯特·普拉特恩去世后，该席位出缺。他的侄子、民族党候选人格雷厄姆·普拉特恩赢得补选。

en.s: The 1929 Campeonato de Portugal Final was the final match of the 1928–29 Campeonato de Portugal, the 8th season of the Campeonato de Portugal, the Portuguese football knockout tournament, organized by the Portuguese Football Federation (FPF). The match was played on 16 June 1929 at the Campo de Palhavã in Lisbon between Belenenses and União de Lisboa. Belenenses defeated União de Lisboa 2–1 to claim their second Campeonato de Portugal.

zh.s: 1929年葡萄牙锦标赛决赛是1928—29赛季的决赛，也是由葡萄牙足球协会（FPF）主办的这项葡萄牙淘汰制足球赛事的第八个赛季。比赛于1929年6月16日在里斯本帕尔哈旺球场举行，对阵双方是贝伦人和里斯本联盟。贝伦人以2比1获胜，第二次赢得葡萄牙锦标赛。

en.s: The 1932 Manitoba general election was held on June 16, 1932, to elect Members of the Legislative Assembly of the province of Manitoba, Canada. A Liberal-Progressive majority government was elected. This was the second election in Manitoba where two types of preferential voting was used in all electoral divisions. Winnipeg elected ten members through single transferable ballot, while all other constituencies elected one member by instant runoff voting.

zh.s: 加拿大曼尼托巴省于1932年6月16日举行大选，选出省议会议员。自由党—进步党赢得多数席位并组建多数派政府。这是曼尼托巴省首次在所有选区采用两种偏好投票制度：温尼伯选出10名议员，采用单记可转移投票制；其他所有选区各选出1名议员，采用即时决选投票制。

en.t: Roosevelt signs the National Industrial Recovery Act
en.s: On June 16, 1933, US President Franklin D. Roosevelt signed the National Industrial Recovery Act into law. The New Deal measure created the National Recovery Administration, authorized industry-wide fair-competition codes and collective bargaining protections, and established a federal public works program.
en.n: The bill had cleared Congress earlier; June 16 is the signing and approval date.

zh.t: 罗斯福签署《国家工业复兴法》
zh.s: 1933年6月16日，美国总统富兰克林·罗斯福签署《国家工业复兴法》。这项新政法案设立全国复兴署，允许各行业制定公平竞争规则，保障工人集体谈判权，并启动联邦公共工程计划。
zh.n: 国会此前已通过法案；6月16日是总统签署生效的日期。

en.t: Philippe Pétain becomes prime minister of France
en.s: On June 16, 1940, French Prime Minister Paul Reynaud resigned as German forces advanced. President Albert Lebrun appointed Philippe Pétain to replace him. Pétain's government moved toward seeking an armistice with Germany; the later Vichy regime was established in July, not on this day.
en.n: June 16 marks Pétain's appointment as prime minister, not the creation of Vichy France.

zh.s: 1940年6月16日，德军进逼法国之际，总理保罗·雷诺辞职。总统阿尔贝·勒布伦任命菲利普·贝当接任总理。贝当政府随后寻求与德国停战；维希政权直到同年7月才建立。
zh.n: 6月16日是贝当出任总理的日期，并非维希政权成立的日期。

en.s: Convoy HX 133 was the 133rd of the numbered series of World War II HX convoys of merchant ships from HalifaX to Liverpool. The ships departed Halifax on 16 June 1941, and were found on 23 June by U-boats of the 1st U-boat Flotilla, operating out of Brest, France. U-boats sank six ships before the convoy reached Liverpool on 3 July.

zh.s: HX 133船队是第二次世界大战期间编号为HX的商船船队系列中的第133支，从哈利法克斯驶往利物浦。船队于1941年6月16日从哈利法克斯启航，6月23日被驻扎在法国布雷斯特的德国第一潜艇支队发现。潜艇击沉6艘船后，船队于7月3日抵达利物浦。

en.s: Operation Vigorous ( Italian: Battaglia di mezzo giugno 1942, "the Battle of mid-June") was a British operation during the Second World War, to escort supply Convoy MW 11 from the eastern Mediterranean to Malta, which took place from 11 to 16 June 1942. Vigorous was part of Operation Julius, a simultaneous operation with Operation Harpoon from Gibraltar and supporting operations.

zh.s: 活力行动（意大利语：Battaglia di mezzo giugno 1942，意为“六月中旬战役”）是第二次世界大战期间英国的一次行动，目的是护送MW 11补给船队从东地中海前往马耳他。行动于1942年6月11日至16日进行，是“朱利叶斯行动”的一部分；“朱利叶斯行动”还包括从直布罗陀出发的“鱼叉行动”和其他支援行动。

en.s: Operation SO and SE (ソ作戦とセ作戦, SO Sakusen to SE Sakusen) were parts of an aerial offensive launched by Imperial Japanese forces against Allied forces staging around Guadalcanal area during the Solomon Islands Campaign in the Pacific Theater of World War II. The aerial offensive took place between 7 and 16 June 1943 and was aimed at destroying Allied air power and shipping.

zh.s: SO和SE行动（日语：ソ作戦とセ作戦）是第二次世界大战太平洋战场所罗门群岛战役期间，日本帝国军队对瓜达尔卡纳尔岛周边盟军集结地发动的空袭行动。空袭于1943年6月7日至16日进行，目标是摧毁盟军的空中力量和船只。

en.s: Operation Schwarz (German: Unternehmen Schwarz), also known as the Fifth Enemy Offensive (Serbo-Croatian Latin: Peta neprijateljska ofanziva) in Yugoslav historiography and often identified with its final phase, the Battle of the Sutjeska (Serbo-Croatian Latin: Bitka na Sutjesci pronounced [bîtka na sûtjɛst͡si]) was a joint attack by the Axis. Taking place from 15 May to 16 June 1943, it aimed to destroy the main Yugoslav Partisan force, near the Sutjeska River in south-eastern Bosnia.

zh.s: 施瓦茨行动（德语：Unternehmen Schwarz）在南斯拉夫史学中也称“第五次敌军攻势”，其最后阶段常被称为苏捷斯卡战役。轴心国联军于1943年5月15日至6月16日发动这次联合攻势，目标是在波斯尼亚东南部苏捷斯卡河附近摧毁南斯拉夫游击队主力。

en.s: The bombing of Yawata (Yahata kūshū) on the night of 15–16 June 1944 marked the beginning of the United States Army Air Forces (USAAF) strategic bombing campaign against the Japanese home islands during the Pacific War and was the first such raid to employ strategic bombers. The raid was undertaken by 75 Boeing B-29 Superfortress heavy bombers staging from bases in China.

en.s: The Sungai Siput incident is an event that marked the beginning of the Malayan Emergency on 16 June 1948. Three European plantation managers were killed at Sungai Siput, Perak. Elphil Estate manager A.E. Walker was shot in at his office desk at 8.30am. Nearby manager John Alison and his assistant Ian Christian of the Phin Soon Estate were killed about 30 minutes later.

zh.s: 双溪西布事件标志着马来亚紧急状态于1948年6月16日开始。霹雳州双溪西布有3名欧洲种植园经理被杀。艾尔菲尔庄园经理A·E·沃克于早上8时30分在办公室办公桌旁遭枪击身亡。约30分钟后，附近菲恩顺庄园的经理约翰·艾利森和助理伊恩·克里斯蒂安也被杀。

en.t: Plantation killings prompt emergency measures in Malaya
en.s: On June 16, 1948, two European plantation managers and one assistant were killed at neighbouring estates in central Perak. The British High Commissioner immediately proclaimed emergency measures in the affected part of Perak and two areas of Johor, giving police expanded powers. These attacks and the colonial response marked the opening of the Malayan Emergency; emergency rule was extended across the federation later.
en.n: June 16 is the date of the killings and initial local emergency measures, not the date of a federation-wide emergency proclamation.

zh.t: 马来亚种植园遇袭后，英殖民当局实施紧急措施
zh.s: 1948年6月16日，马来亚霹雳州中部相邻的种植园里，两名欧洲籍经理和一名助理遇害。英国高级专员随即在霹雳州事发地区及柔佛州两处地区实行紧急措施，扩大警察的搜查和拘留权。这些袭击及其后的殖民当局应对，被视为马来亚紧急状态的开端。
zh.n: 6月16日发生了种植园袭击，并开始在部分地区实施紧急措施；全马来亚的紧急状态并非这天宣布。

en.s: The 1951 Prahran state by-election was held on 16 June 1951 to elect the member for Prahran in the Victorian Legislative Assembly, following the resignation of Labor Party MP Frank Crean. Crean resigned to contest the federal election on 28 April 1951, where he was elected as the member for Melbourne Ports. Robert Pettiona retained the seat for Labor despite a swing of 2.9% towards the Liberal and Country Party (LCP).

zh.s: 1951年普拉兰州议会补选于1951年6月16日举行，改选维多利亚州议会普拉兰选区议员。工党议员弗兰克·克里恩辞职后，该席位出缺；他辞职是为了参加4月28日的联邦选举，并当选墨尔本港选区议员。尽管选情向自由党和乡村党倾斜2.9个百分点，工党候选人罗伯特·佩蒂奥纳仍保住席位。

en.s: The Copa del Generalísimo 1957 final was the 55th final of the King's Cup. The final was played at Montjuic in Barcelona, on 16 June 1957, being won by CF Barcelona, who beat RCD Español 1–0.

en.s: The 1958 Manitoba general election was held on June 16, 1958 to elect Members of the Legislative Assembly of the Province of Manitoba, Canada. The election resulted in a minority victory for the Progressive Conservative Party under the leadership of Dufferin Roblin. This election was the first in Manitoba after a comprehensive electoral redistribution in 1956. The redistribution saw the city of Winnipeg abandon its three four-member districts.

zh.s: 加拿大曼尼托巴省于1958年6月16日举行大选，选出省议会议员。达弗林·罗布林领导的进步保守党以少数席位获胜。1956年该省全面重新划分选区后，这是首次举行大选；重新划分选区后，温尼伯市不再采用三个四席位选区。

en.s: Imre Nagy (7 June 1896 – 16 June 1958) was a Hungarian Communist politician who served as Chairman of the Council of Ministers (Prime Minister) of the Hungarian People's Republic from 1953 to 1955. In 1956 Nagy became leader of the Hungarian Revolution of 1956 against the Soviet-backed government, for which he was sentenced to death and executed two years later.

zh.s: 伊姆雷·纳吉（1896年6月7日—1958年6月16日）是匈牙利共产党政治人物，曾于1953至1955年担任匈牙利人民共和国部长会议主席（总理）。1956年，纳吉领导了反抗苏联支持政府的匈牙利革命；他因此被判处死刑，并于两年后遭处决。

en.t: The film was released on June 16, 1960, at the DeMille Theatre and the Baronet Theatre in New York City
en.s: Psycho is a 1960 American horror thriller film produced and directed by Alfred Hitchcock. The screenplay, written by Joseph Stefano, is based on the 1959 novel by Robert Bloch. The film stars Anthony Perkins, Janet Leigh, Vera Miles, John Gavin, and Martin Balsam. The plot centers on an encounter between on-the-run embezzler Marion Crane (Leigh), shy motel proprietor Norman Bates (Perkins), and his disturbed mother.

zh.t: 《惊魂记》于1960年6月16日在纽约德米尔影院和巴罗内特影院首映
zh.s: 《惊魂记》是1960年美国恐怖惊悚片，由阿尔弗雷德·希区柯克制片并执导。剧本由约瑟夫·斯特凡诺撰写，改编自罗伯特·布洛赫1959年的小说。安东尼·珀金斯、珍妮特·利、维拉·迈尔斯、约翰·加文和马丁·鲍尔萨姆出演。影片讲述了在逃贪款犯玛丽昂·克兰（利饰）、性格内向的汽车旅馆老板诺曼·贝茨（珀金斯饰）及其精神失常的母亲之间的故事。
zh.n: 美国电影学会目录将1960年6月16日列为纽约首映日期，并另列1960年8月为发行月份。

en.s: The 1963 Championnat National 1 final was the first final of the Algerian Championnat after the country's independence. The match took place on June 16, 1963, at Stade d'El Anasser in Algiers with kick-off at 15:00. USM Alger beat MC Alger 3–0 to win their first Algerian Championnat.

zh.t: 1963年阿尔及利亚全国甲级联赛决赛
zh.s: 1963年阿尔及利亚全国甲级联赛决赛是阿尔及利亚独立后举行的首场联赛决赛。比赛于1963年6月16日15时在阿尔及尔的埃尔阿纳塞尔体育场举行。阿尔及尔USM以3比0击败阿尔及尔穆卢迪亚，首次赢得阿尔及利亚全国甲级联赛冠军。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Yugoslavia in June 1963. They were the first held under the 1963 constitution which created a five-chamber Federal Assembly. Only one chamber, the 120-seat Federal Council, was chosen by universal suffrage, with its election taking place on 16 June. The other four chambers, the Economic Council, the Educational-Cultural Council, the Social and Heath Council and the Organizational-Political Council were elected between 3 and 16 June by people employed or specializing in a related industry.

zh.s: 南斯拉夫于1963年举行议会选举，这是1963年宪法通过后首次举行的选举，新宪法设立了五院制联邦议会。只有120席的联邦委员会由普选产生，投票日期为6月16日。其他四个委员会——经济委员会、教育文化委员会、社会与卫生委员会、组织政治委员会——于6月3日至16日由相关行业从业人员或专业人士选出。

en.s: The Battle of Hill 488 was a military engagement of the Vietnam War that took place on the night of 15–16 June 1966. A small United States Marine Corps (USMC) reconnaissance platoon inflicted large casualties on regular People's Army of Vietnam (PAVN) and Viet Cong (VC) fighters before withdrawing with only a few dead.

The match was played on 16 June 1968 at the Estádio Nacional in Oeiras, and opposed two Primeira Liga sides: Porto and Vitória de Setúbal.

It was disputed between Dinamo București and Rapid București, and was won by Dinamo București after a game with 4 goals after extra time. Alexandru Neagu failed a penalty in 90 minutes for Rapid București. It was the 3rd cup for Dinamo București.

zh.s: 1968年罗马尼亚杯决赛是该国最重要的足球杯赛的第30届决赛，由布加勒斯特迪纳摩和布加勒斯特快速队交锋。经过加时赛、打入4球后，迪纳摩获胜。第90分钟时，快速队球员亚历山德鲁·尼亚古罚失点球。这是迪纳摩第三次夺冠。

en.s: The 1970 Newark mayoral election was held on June 16, 1970. Incumbent mayor Hugh Addonizio ran for a third term in office but was defeated by civil engineer Kenneth A. Gibson. Gibson became the first black man elected mayor of a major city in the Northeastern United States or Eastern Seaboard. Gibson finished first in a primary election on May 12 but did not receive a majority of the vote.

zh.s: 纽瓦克市于1970年6月16日举行市长选举。寻求第三个任期的现任市长休·阿多尼齐奥败给土木工程师肯尼斯·A·吉布森。吉布森成为美国东北部或东海岸主要城市中首位经选举当选的黑人市长。他在5月12日举行的初选中排名第一，但没有获得过半数选票。

en.s: The 1974 Greek Cup final was the 30th final of the Greek Cup. The match took place on 16 June 1974 at Nikos Goumas Stadium. The contesting teams were PAOK and Olympiacos for a second time in row. It was PAOK's eighth Greek Cup final and fifth consecutive in their 48 years of existence and Olympiacos' nineteenth Greek Cup final and second consecutive in their 49-year history.

zh.s: 1974年希腊杯决赛是该项赛事的第30场决赛，于1974年6月16日在尼科斯·古马斯体育场举行。参赛球队是塞萨洛尼基PAOK和奥林匹亚科斯，这是两队连续第二年在决赛交手。PAOK在成立48年间第八次闯入希腊杯决赛，也是连续第五年进入决赛；奥林匹亚科斯在成立49年间第19次闯入决赛，也是连续第二年进入决赛。

en.s: The Italian regional elections of 1975 were held on 15 and 16 June. The fifteen ordinary regions, created in 1970, elected their second assemblies. Following the 1971 census, Piedmont, Veneto and Lazio had ten more seats each.

en.s: The Soweto Uprising was a series of protests led by high school students in South Africa that began on the morning of 16 June 1976. Students from numerous Sowetan schools began to protest in the streets of Soweto in response to the introduction of Afrikaans as the medium of instruction in local schools. It is estimated that 20,000 students took part in the protests. They were met with fierce police brutality. The number of protesters killed by police is usually given as 176, but estimates of up to 700 have been made.

zh.s: 索韦托起义是1976年6月16日上午在南非爆发的一系列由高中生领导的抗议活动。索韦托多所学校的学生走上街头，反对当地学校开始以南非语授课。据估计约有20,000名学生参加抗议。他们遭到警方暴力镇压。警方造成的死亡人数通常记为176人，但也有估计认为多达700人遇难。

en.s: The Irish general election of 1977 was held on 16 June 1977 and is regarded as a pivotal point in twentieth-century Irish politics. The general election took place in 42 parliamentary constituencies throughout Southern Ireland for 148 seats in the lower house of parliament, Dáil Éireann. The number of seats in the Dáil was increased by 4 from 144 to 148. The newly elected 148 members of the 21st Dáil assembled at Leinster House on 5 July when a new Fianna Fáil government replaced the incumbent Fine Gael–Labour Party coalition, with Jack Lynch becoming Taoiseach for the second time.

zh.s: 爱尔兰于1977年6月16日举行大选，被视为20世纪爱尔兰政治的转折点。爱尔兰南部42个议会选区改选下议院爱尔兰众议院148个席位，席位数从144个增加到148个。新当选的第21届众议院148名议员于7月5日在伦斯特府召开会议，爱尔兰共和党随后取代统一党—工党联合政府执政，杰克·林奇第二次出任总理。

en.t: Liberal Party of Canada leadership election, 1984
en.s: A Liberal Party of Canada leadership election was called for June 16, 1984, to replace retiring Liberal leader and sitting Prime Minister Pierre Trudeau. The convention elected former Finance Minister John Turner, who at the time was not sitting in the House of Commons, as its leader on the second ballot, defeating another former finance minister, Jean Chrétien.

zh.s: 加拿大自由党于1984年6月16日举行党魁选举，接替即将退休的党魁兼现任总理皮埃尔·特鲁多。大会选出前财政部长约翰·特纳为党魁；当时他并非众议院议员。特纳在第二轮投票中击败另一位前财政部长让·克雷蒂安。

en.s: A by-election in the Rakovica I constituency in Serbia was held in June 1991. The election was called after the death of representative Miodrag Bulatović of the Socialist Party of Serbia (SPS), and was contested by Radoš Karaklajić of SPS, Vojislav Šešelj of the Serbian Radical Party, Borislav Pekić of the Democratic Party and ten other candidates. zh.s: 1991年，塞尔维亚拉科维察I选区举行议会补选。此次补选由塞尔维亚社会党议员米奥德拉格·布拉托维奇去世引发。候选人包括塞尔维亚社会党候选人拉多什·卡拉克拉伊奇、塞尔维亚激进党候选人沃伊斯拉夫·舍舍利、民主党候选人鲍里斯拉夫·佩基奇及其他10人。塞尔维亚民族复兴党和塞尔维亚民主党也支持舍舍利参选。

en.s: The 1996 Great American Bash was a professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by World Championship Wrestling (WCW). It was the sixth Great American Bash under the WCW banner and 10th Great American Bash event overall. It took place on June 16, 1996, at the Baltimore Arena in Baltimore, Maryland. This was the fifth Great American Bash held at this venue after the 1988, 1989, 1990, and 1991 events.

zh.s: 1996年Great American Bash是世界冠军摔角（WCW）制作的职业摔角按次付费赛事。这是WCW旗下第六届Great American Bash，也是该系列第10场赛事。比赛于1996年6月16日在马里兰州巴尔的摩竞技场举行。这是该场馆举办的第五届赛事，此前四届分别在1988、1989、1990和1991年举行。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Russia on 16 June 1996, with a second round being held on 3 July 1996. It resulted in a victory for the incumbent Russian president Boris Yeltsin, who ran as an independent politician. Yeltsin defeated the Communist Party of the Russian Federation challenger Gennady Zyuganov in the second round, receiving 54.4% of the vote. Yeltsin's second inauguration ceremony took place on 9 August 1996.

zh.s: 俄罗斯于1996年6月16日举行总统选举，并于7月3日进行第二轮投票。现任总统鲍里斯·叶利钦以独立候选人身份参选并获胜。他在第二轮中击败俄罗斯联邦共产党候选人格根纳季·久加诺夫，得票率为54.4%。叶利钦于1996年8月9日举行第二次就职典礼。

en.s: The Daïat Labguer (M'sila) massacre took place on June 16, 1997 - less than two weeks after parliamentary elections - in the hamlet of Daïat Labguer (M'sila) (also (mis)spelled Dairat Labguar, Dairat Lebguar, Daïat Labguer, Daïret Lebguer, Dairet Lebguer) near M'sila, 300 km southeast of Algiers. About 50 people were killed by some 30 guerrillas, who also kidnapped women, killed the livestock, and stole jewels. Five days earlier, another 17 had been killed at a village some 5 km away. The massacre was attributed to Islamist groups such as the GIA.

zh.t: 代亚特拉布格尔（姆西拉）屠杀
zh.s: 代亚特拉布格尔（姆西拉）屠杀于1997年6月16日发生在姆西拉附近的代亚特拉布格尔村，距阿尔及尔东南约300公里，距议会选举不到两周。约30名游击队员杀害了约50人，还绑架妇女、宰杀牲畜并偷走珠宝。5天前，约5公里外的另一座村庄有17人遇害。此次屠杀被归咎于伊斯兰武装组织，例如伊斯兰武装组织（GIA）。

en.s: The French legislative elections took place on 9 June and 16 June 2002 to elect the 12th National Assembly of the Fifth Republic, in a context of political crisis. The Socialist Prime Minister Lionel Jospin announced his political retirement after his elimination at the first round of the 2002 French presidential election. President Jacques Chirac was easily reelected, all the Republican parties having called to block far-right leader Jean-Marie Le Pen. Chirac's conservative supporters created the Union for the Presidential Majority (Union pour la majorité présidentielle or UMP) to prepare for the legislative elections.

zh.s: 法国于2002年6月9日和16日举行议会选举，选出第五共和国第12届国民议会，选举时正值政治危机。社会党总理利昂内尔·若斯潘在2002年法国总统选举首轮出局后宣布退出政坛。总统雅克·希拉克轻松连任；共和党各党派都呼吁选民阻止极右翼领袖让-马里·勒庞当选。希拉克的保守派支持者成立“总统多数联盟”（UMP），为议会选举做准备。

en.s: The 2003 general election was held in the British Virgin Islands on 16 June 2003. It was won by the opposition National Democratic Party (NDP), which took 54.4% of the vote and 8 of the 13 available seats on the Legislative Council. After the election the NDP formed a Government for the first time in its history. Both major parties - the NDP and the Virgin Islands Party (VIP) actually increased their share of the overall vote at the expense of minority parties and independents. No independents or any minority parties won any seats. The NDP won all four of the territorial-at-large seats.

zh.s: 英属维尔京群岛于2003年6月16日举行大选。反对党国家民主党（NDP）获胜，取得54.4%的选票和立法委员会13席中的8席，并在该党历史上首次组建政府。两大党——NDP和维尔京群岛党（VIP）——都提高了得票率，挤压了小党和独立候选人的支持率。没有独立候选人或小党赢得席位。NDP赢得全部4个全境选区席位。

en.s: Two leadership spills of the Australian Labor Party (ALP), the official opposition party in the Parliament of Australia, were held on 16 June 2003 and 2 December 2003, respectively. en.s: Operation Marne Torch refers to two operations launched by Coalition forces in 2007 against al-Qaeda in Iraq in the Arab Jabour area of Babil province. This campaign is named after Operation Torch, the joint US/British invasion of French North Africa in 1942, presumably because of the two operations' similar thrust in to the enemies southern underbelly. The first operation, Marne Torch I began on 16 June 2007, when Multinational Division Central launched offensive operations against Sunni and Shi'ia extremists, as well as insurgents with Iranian influence in the city and surrounding regions of Arab Jabour in Babil province.

zh.s: 马恩火炬行动指联军于2007年在巴比伦省阿拉伯朱布尔地区发动的两次针对伊拉克基地组织的军事行动。这场行动以1942年美英联军入侵法属北非的“火炬行动”命名，可能是因为两次行动都从南侧深入敌方腹地。第一次行动“马恩火炬一号”于2007年6月16日开始，中央多国师对巴比伦省阿拉伯朱布尔市及周边地区的逊尼派和什叶派极端分子，以及受伊朗影响的叛乱分子发动攻势。

en.s: Operation Phantom Thunder began on 16 June 2007, when Multi-National Force-Iraq launched major offensive operations against al-Qaeda and other extremist terrorists operating throughout Iraq. Operation Phantom Thunder was a corps level operation, including Operation Arrowhead Ripper in Diyala Province, Operation Marne Torch and Operation Commando Eagle in Babil Province, Operation Fardh al-Qanoon in Baghdad, Operation Alljah in Anbar Province, and continuing special forces actions against the Mahdi Army in southern Iraq and against Al-Qaeda leadership throughout the country. The operation was one of the biggest military operations in Iraq since the U.S. invasion in 2003.

zh.s: 雷霆幽灵行动于2007年6月16日开始，驻伊拉克多国部队对伊拉克各地的基地组织及其他极端恐怖组织发动大规模攻势。这是一场军级行动，包括在迪亚拉省实施的“箭头撕裂行动”、在巴比伦省实施的“马恩火炬行动”和“突击队之鹰行动”、巴格达的“法律与秩序行动”、安巴尔省的“全方位行动”，以及在伊拉克南部继续针对迈赫迪军、在全国范围打击基地组织领导层的特种部队行动。这是自2003年美国入侵伊拉克以来规模最大的军事行动之一。

en.t: Al-Qaeda announces Ayman al-Zawahiri as its new leader
en.s: On June 16, 2011, al-Qaeda announced through jihadist websites that Ayman al-Zawahiri had succeeded Osama bin Laden as its leader. Bin Laden had been killed in a U.S. operation on May 2. en.s: A parliamentary by-election was held in Bahrain on June 16, 2012, to elect a new member of the Council of Representatives for District 8 of the Muharraq Governorate. The winner of the elections was former Muharraq Municipal Councillor Sameer Kadhem, decided in a run-off vote held on June 23, 2012. The turnout of the first round of voting was 37.2%, as a total of 3,029 votes were cast out of a total 8,128 registered voters.

en.t: China successfully launches its Shenzhou 9 spacecraft, carrying three astronauts, including the first female Chinese astronaut Liu Yang, to the Tiangong-1 orbital module
en.s: Shenzhou 9 (Chinese: 神舟九号) was the fourth crewed spacecraft flight of China's Shenzhou program, launched at 18:37:24 CST (10:37:24 UTC), 16 June 2012. Shenzhou 9 was the second spacecraft and first crewed mission and expedition to dock with the Tiangong-1 space station, which took place on 18 June. The Shenzhou 9 spacecraft landed at 10:01:16 CST (02:01:16 UTC) on 29 June in the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region.

en.t: Rostov-on-Don pre-trial detention center hostage crisis
en.s: On 16 June 2024, a hostage situation occurred at a detention center in Rostov-on-Don, Rostov Oblast, Russia. The hostage takers, all Islamic State militants who were previously detained at the center, were shot and killed except one militant captured alive, two employees were rescued. Six men, armed with knives, took two prison guards hostage. The hostage-takers demanded a vehicle, weapons and safe passage out of the center.

zh.s: 2024年6月16日，俄罗斯罗斯托夫州顿河畔罗斯托夫一处拘留中心发生人质事件。6名持刀男子挟持两名狱警。挟持者都是曾被关押在该中心的伊斯兰国武装分子，最终除1人被活捉外，其余均遭击毙；两名工作人员获救。挟持者要求提供车辆、武器，并允许他们安全离开拘留中心。
